criteria.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs exists and holds SnapExec with its Exec impl, take_baseline and baseline_checks. Their bodies are textually identical to the originals in run/mod.rs, apart from visibility and import lines, and mod.rs no longer defines them (Grep 'fn take_baseline|fn baseline_checks|struct SnapExec' finds them only in checks.rs).
criteria.evidence: Grep 'fn take_baseline|fn baseline_checks|struct SnapExec' over crates/ finds them only in run/checks.rs, at lines 7, 52 and 80. `git diff -M --color-moved` marks every body line as moved. The lines it does not mark are: the new file's //! header, `use super::*;`, the `impl Athena {` wrapper, the `pub(super)` lines on the struct, its fields and take_baseline, and the last two lines of take_baseline's signature, which rustfmt wrapped over several lines. The CHANGELOG reports each of these.

criteria.criterion: Public paths are unchanged. Any item reachable before the move, such as athena_core::run::..., is still reachable through a re-export or import in mod.rs. The git diff of test code shows only edited import lines, and no test is added, removed or renamed.
criteria.evidence: All three moved items were private before the move: `struct SnapExec`, `fn take_baseline` and `fn baseline_checks`. So no public path changed, and a re-export is not required. mod.rs adds `mod checks;` and `use checks::SnapExec;`, and the existing call `self.take_baseline` at producer.rs:53 still resolves. The diff changes no test line, no test module and no file under tests/. check_seam stays in mod.rs. The workspace compiles, and the athena-core tests pass.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for R7 that lists each moved name with its caller check (producer.rs take_baseline call, mod.rs SnapExec construction) and states that no behavior changed. It pairs any early return with its Flow::Stop using old and new line numbers, or says there are none.
criteria.evidence: The new R7 bullet names SnapExec with its Exec impl, take_baseline and baseline_checks, and says "No behavior changed". For callers it gives take_baseline at producer.rs line 53, baseline_checks called only by take_baseline, and SnapExec constructed once in mod.rs (Grep finds it at mod.rs:1241). It names the one `return baseline`, at old line 1142 and new line 68 of checks.rs. I counted both line numbers from the diff hunks and they are correct. It explains that this return has no Flow::Stop pairing because it returns from the moved method, not from produce_and_verify.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`. All pass, and the test count equals the pre-change count (1737 in the R6 landing).
criteria.evidence: Athena's recorded checks on this tree: fmt passed, clippy passed, and cargo test --locked passed with 1737 tests, the same count as the R6 landing. I also ran targeted tests that use the moved code: 7 'baseline' tests, including a_fake_job_takes_its_baseline_before_the_producer..., and 27 run:: tests that drive SnapExec through check_seam, including a_check_killed_at_its_deadline... and a_real_nonzero_check_failure_is_still_rejected. All of them passed.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked -- --list` on the change. Its test list has the same test names as before the change, apart from module paths that shift only if tests moved. None are expected to move.
criteria.evidence: I ran the listing on the candidate and it succeeded. I could not compare it directly with the base list, because checking out base would change git state, and the tool would not let me read the saved list output. The list is shown to be unchanged because the diff touches no test code, so no name can change, and the recorded total is 1737, equal to the pre-change count. athena-core shows 688 unit tests, with the test modules still at their run:: paths.

summary: The change passes: it is the verbatim move that R7 asked for, with no behaviour change. SnapExec (the struct and its Exec impl), take_baseline and baseline_checks now live in a new run/checks.rs, and run/mod.rs no longer defines them. A git diff that colours moved lines marks every body line as moved; the only unmarked lines are visibility changes, the new file's header and imports, and rustfmt's rewrap of take_baseline's signature, and the CHANGELOG reports each of them. All three items were private, so no public path changed and no re-export is needed. No test code was edited. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test runs passed with 1737 tests, the same as the R6 landing. I also ran 7 baseline tests and 27 run:: tests that use the moved code, and all passed. I could not compare the test list with the base directly, because that would mean checking out the base commit; since no test line changed and the count matches, the list is unchanged. The CHANGELOG entry lists the moved names and their callers, and places the one early return at old line 1142 and new line 68, which I checked against the diff. It explains why that return has no Flow::Stop pairing. One minor gap: the caller check gives call sites but not the before and after file counts that the design doc asks for (structure-pass §5 item 5).
